concepts.title: Точка опоры
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE professionally art-directed 16:9 landscape brand identity concept for "ЕТОР", a Russian unified territory of accelerated development, supporting serious investment, enterprise and regional projects. It is a future umbrella brand. This is a brand-new alternative concept. Design an original distinct standalone symbol PLUS carefully designed name. The exact name is CYRILLIC "ЕТОР", FOUR letters Е-Т-О-Р; the final Cyrillic Р looks like Latin P, never R. Make the name immediately readable, even kerning, open counters, clean optical alignment. Communicate one idea through exceptional drawing and controlled spacing. A beautiful premium contemporary design-studio presentation, calm, concrete, confidently simple. Main flat master logo should take at least half the composition and remain the first read; show its isolated sign as part of the composition or the exact same mark on the one subordinate application. A real application must match its geometry and typography, may carry only "ЕТОР". Optional full descriptor is exactly "Единая территория опережающего развития", small and correct; use no other slogans or claims. Strictly no presentation headings, variant numbers, swatch lists, sample letters, diagrams, grids of alternatives, English, fake legal copy or invented names. Keep flat monochrome ink shapes in the master, no logo gradients, bevels, 3D icon, shadows or textures. Do not copy existing brands. NO two-piece capsule O, broken link, blue tension sling, ЕТ shared roof ligature, open-door icon, slanted racing type, heraldic retro or institutional crest. ONE concept per image. Strong brand thinking with a coherent repeating graphic idea and generous negative space.
CONCEPT CONSTRUCTION
A compact symbol of a single filled circle resting precisely in the inside corner of a thick L-shaped support. Circle and L remain separate; it reads as something reliably supported, an abstract architectural balancing joint. The L has a confidently extended foot, circle diameter equals twice arm thickness. Pair with an assured medium-weight humane Cyrillic grotesk, subtle round counters, generous E/T spacing.
PALETTE
deep forest green, warm ivory, very small citrus accent
COMPOSITION AND APPLICATION
Large ivory canvas, symbol and name horizontally at center-left. One small concrete entrance plaque with the same green mark integrated at right, natural tactile architectural light.
